name: Paul Venn
title: Senior communications and events professional
bio_short: Senior communications and events professional with almost 20 years' Middle East experience. Clients include General Motors, Pepsi, Unilever, Etisalat and Majid Al Futtaim. Currently at CARMA. Former MEPRA board member. UK-based.
bio: Paul is a senior communications and events professional with almost 20 years' Middle East experience covering all phases of corporate, event, brand and government communications. He currently works with CARMA, the global media intelligence firm. He has held senior roles both in-house and agency-side with regional and global agencies, developing and delivering PR strategies, internal and external communication programmes, media relations, crisis communication and event management for organisations including twofour54, General Motors, Pepsi, Unilever, Etisalat, National Bank of Dubai and Majid Al Futtaim. He is a former board member of the Middle East Public Relations Association (MEPRA).  Paul has worked extensively across the GCC, developing particular expertise in government communications and the communication challenges associated with major events, infrastructure projects and national brand campaigns. He understands the political, cultural and commercial dynamics of the region.  At ISOC, Paul delivers corporate communications, crisis communication and event communications programmes. His combined in-house and agency experience gives him a dual perspective that is valuable for participants from both environments. His media intelligence work adds an analytical dimension: he understands not just how to create communications but how to measure their impact. His deep Middle East experience makes him particularly effective for training programmes in the Gulf. Paul is based in the UK and trains in English.
